description: Migrate the S3 module from src/s3/ to libs/s3/ to establish a proper library structure for shared infrastructure modules. This refactoring separates infrastructure concerns from domain logic and establishes patterns for future migrations.

userStories.title: Create libs directory structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a libs/ directory at the project root so that infrastructure modules can be organized separately from domain logic.
acceptanceCriteria: libs/ directory exists at project root
Directory structure follows NestJS module conventions

userStories.title: Move S3 module files to libs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want S3 module files moved to libs/s3/ so that the module is organized as a shared infrastructure library.
acceptanceCriteria: All S3 module files moved to libs/s3/ using git mv (preserves history)
Files moved: s3.module.ts, s3.service.ts, s3.module.spec.ts, s3.service.spec.ts
Git history preserved (verified with git log --follow libs/s3/s3.service.ts)

userStories.title: Create barrel export for S3 module
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a barrel export (index.ts) in libs/s3/ so that imports can use @libs/s3 instead of explicit file paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Imports work with both @libs/s3 and @libs/s3/s3.module patterns

userStories.title: Configure TypeScript path aliases
userStories.description: As a developer, I want TypeScript configured to resolve @libs/* path aliases so that imports work correctly across the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json includes @libs/* path mapping to libs/*
tsconfig.json includes libs/**/* in compilation paths

userStories.title: Configure Jest path mapping for libs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Jest configured to resolve @libs/* paths using ts-jest so that tests can import from libs without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json jest config includes moduleNameMapper for @libs/*
S3Service tests work with new import paths
S3Module tests work with new import paths

userStories.title: Update all S3 import statements
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all S3 imports updated to use @libs/s3 so that the codebase references the correct module location.
acceptanceCriteria: No references to src/s3/ or ../s3/ remain

userStories.title: Verify functionality after migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all existing functionality to work after migration so that no breaking changes are introduced.
acceptanceCriteria: S3 service methods work correctly (downloadMarkdownFile, generatePresignedPostUrl)
No runtime errors related to module resolution

userStories.title: Update .cursorrules documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want .cursorrules updated to document the libs structure so that future development follows established patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: .cursorrules includes section on libs directory structure
Documents what belongs in libs/ vs src/

userStories.title: Create libs README documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a libs/README.md documenting the libs structure so that patterns are clear for future migrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Explains what belongs in libs vs src
Lists current libs (S3) and planned migrations
